statusText: Tail firms slightly to 12%. Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ Dec26 has printed a marginal new overnight low at 31,349.50 and trades 11 points above it, a mild directional tilt rather than extension, while Stress rises to 51% on hawkish September FOMC minutes, a 10-year that reached 5.36% and a softer Nikkei.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON with Tail at 12%, well below the 25% blocking threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers 13:30Z-15:00Z around the US cash open, and conditional Tail reaches its 21% WATCH peak only in the hour containing that open. Jobless claims at 12:30Z and the 17:00Z 30-year auction are the session's other checkpoints.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures test the low of a narrow overnight band while hawkish Fed minutes hold yields at multi-decade highs
body: The fifth Globex hour of the Oct 7-8 session shows a mild downward tilt without the structure that defines a pathological price path. NQ Dec26 trades 31,361.00, -0.13% against a 31,402.25 prior close, inside a band of 31,349.50-31,466.00. The low has extended about 23 points below the prior hour's 31,372.25 and NQ sits 11 points above it, so the contract is near its session extreme for the first time this session. Set against that, the band remains only 116.5 points, or 0.37%, wide; earlier Globex hours produced complete round trips of it; and the Oct 7 cash session fully retraced a dip to 30,904.46 before the Nasdaq-100 closed 31,160.08, -0.21%, just 10 points below its 31,170.12 high. That is the opposite of repeated extension after failed retracements. The macro background is where the pressure sits. The September 15-16 FOMC minutes, released Oct 7 at 18:00Z, recorded that most participants judged another increase in the target range would likely be appropriate by year end, from the current 3.75-4.00%. The 10-year reached 5.36% on Oct 7, its highest since April 2002, and the 30-year touched 5.73% before closing near 5.66%. H.15 for Oct 6 puts the 2-year at 4.79%, the 10-year at 5.27% and the 30-year at 5.64%. Brent is holding near or above $100 while maritime-security reporting counts at least 12 attacks or harassment incidents involving tankers around the Strait of Hormuz between Sept 28 and Oct 5, the highest weekly tally since the Iran war began. Asian equities are softer but mean-reverting: the Nikkei 225 at 69,288.58 is -1.07% yet 94 points above its 69,194.12 low. VIX closed Oct 7 at 15.08, giving no evidence of a volatility regime shift. Under the risk contract this stack of hawkish rates, firm crude and geopolitical supply risk raises Stress and leaves Tail low, because none of it is observed persistent one-way NQ structure. Shared Finviz context was read and found stale, dated 2026-09-29 with partial collection status, so it was excluded and the assessment rests on independent primary-source research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 10-14% through the Asian and European hours of Oct 7, rose into a 20-23% WATCH band between 11:00Z and 14:00Z as a trend-down phase developed into the US cash open, then decayed to 10-20% once the dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into the close. Every Globex hour from 20:00Z onward held 10-13% with no WATCH print. Stress climbed steadily from 46% to 50% across the window as long-end yields and crude firmed, and Confidence held 87-89% throughout.
outlookSummary: Base case is continued two-way NQ rotation while hawkish September FOMC minutes, multi-decade-high long-end yields, Brent near $100 and softer Asian cash remain the dominant background conflict. Conditional Tail holds 12% through the remaining Asian hours, rises to 13-16% across the European session and the 08:30Z Waller speech, reaches an 18% print in the hour containing the 12:30Z jobless claims release and a 21% WATCH peak in the hour containing the 13:30Z US cash open, eases to 17-19% through the US morning, lifts marginally to 18% for the 17:00Z 30-year auction and 17:40Z Musalem speech, then decays to 11-15% across the Globex and Asian hours into the Oct 9 afternoon. Confidence declines from 87% to 76% with forecast distance only.

forecast.analysis: Observed: NQ Dec26 trades 31,361.00, -0.13%, inside a 116-point Globex band of 31,349.50-31,466.00 and 11 points above its low after a marginal new session low. No repeated extension and no failed retracement so far; the Nikkei 225 at 69,288.58, -1.07%, sits 94 points above its own session low.
